resources.string: The address you open Flight Deck at — https://deck.example.com, or http://192.168.1.20:25080 for a deck on your local network (plain http only works there).
You sign in on the next screen, with your Flight Deck email and password or a pairing code. A deck started with FD_LOCKDOWN marks its sign-in cookie Secure, so the sign-in only lasts over https.
